directAnswer: To check a mailing list, access your email marketing platform and navigate to the 'Lists' or 'Contacts' section to view the details of your mailing lists.
summary: This guide provides steps to check your mailing list on various platforms, along with potential caveats and frequently asked questions.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The steps to check a mailing list may vary depending on the platform you are using.

sections.heading: Common Platforms
sections.body: Here are steps for popular email marketing platforms.

steps.title: Mailchimp
steps.detail: Log in to Mailchimp, then click on 'Audience' and select 'All contacts' to view your mailing list.

steps.title: Constant Contact
steps.detail: Log in to Constant Contact, go to 'Contacts', and click on 'Lists' to see your mailing lists.

steps.title: Sendinblue
steps.detail: Log in to Sendinblue, navigate to 'Contacts', and select 'Lists' to check your mailing lists.

steps.title: Campaign Monitor
steps.detail: Log in to Campaign Monitor, click on 'Lists & Subscribers', and select the list you want to check.

faqs.question: What should I do if my mailing list is empty?
faqs.answer: You may need to create a new list or import contacts from another source.

faqs.question: How can I add contacts to my mailing list?
faqs.answer: You can add contacts manually or import them from a CSV file, depending on the platform.

faqs.question: Can I segment my mailing list?
faqs.answer: Yes, most platforms allow you to create segments based on various criteria such as engagement or demographics.

caveats: Ensure you have the necessary permissions to access and manage the mailing list.
Steps may vary based on the version of the platform you are using.
